name: Rockport 2026 Forza Ultra — Authentic MW2005 Autumn Cinema & Clearcoat Lighting
description: Max-ceiling lighting & material overhaul for GLOBAL\GLOBALB.LZC preserving Need for Speed: Most Wanted (2005)'s iconic moody late-autumn sunlit atmosphere while eliminating 2005 brown/olive mud: upgrades ALL 5 SunInfos profiles (MIDDAY, SUNSET, PARKLAND, PROTOTYPE, E3DEMO) for crisp golden-autumn sunlit drama and sculptural shadows, re-tunes ROAD for deep cool-slate wet-asphalt contrast with golden sunlit sheen, and upgrades 64 car-paint, pearl, glass, tint, chrome, aluminum, rim, exhaust, mirror, spoiler, carbon, brake, rubber, and traffic LightMaterials for rich 5-face real-time clearcoat reflections. Verified byte-exact against untouched SLUS-21351 and packs in-place inside GLOBALMEMORYFILE.BIN.
